Behind the design ↗
SEARCHASSIST / FOUNDATIONS OF HUMAN COMPUTER INTERACTIONSVersion 0.7 · Exploratory prototype

Three ways to search

The same directory, with different matching and interface behavior.

A · Exact match

Finds a literal, normalized phrase in a title, category, description, or tags. No spelling recovery or stored aliases.

B · Fuzzy search

Adds spelling tolerance, partial words, reordered words, and curated aliases. Displays one ranked list, without explanations.

C · SearchAssist

Uses the same fuzzy engine, with match explanations, highlighted evidence, editable suggestions, and separate approximate results.

This compares an interface bundle. It does not isolate the effect of explanations alone.
